alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 5 at 3:02PM PST until November 6 at 10:00AM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Caruthers - San Joaquin - Selma, Delano-Wasco-Shafter,
Hanford - Corcoran - Lemoore, Merced - Madera - Mendota, Southeast
San Joaquin Valley, and Visalia - Porterville - Reedley.

* WHEN...From midnight tonight to 10 AM PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.
alerts.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.
